# Count occurrences of each regular season place
place_counts = df['Reg. Season'].value_counts()

# Find the place(s) with the maximum count
max_count = place_counts.max()
most_frequent_places = place_counts[place_counts == max_count].index.tolist()

# If there's a tie, return all tied places, otherwise return the single most frequent place
answer = most_frequent_places[0] if len(most_frequent_places) == 1 else most_frequent_places
